```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
# tidyverse covers data manipulation (dplyr, stringr, readr, tidyr, purrr, lubridate)
library(tidyverse)

# Network analysis and visualization
library(igraph)      # core network analysis
library(tidygraph)   # tidy framework for network data
library(ggraph)      # network visualization
library(graphlayouts) # additional network layout algorithms
```

```{r}
# Load the public dataset from the working directory
# This file serves as the basis for all subsequent files in this repository
PublicDF <- read_csv("PublicDF.csv")
```

```{r build-edges-undirected}
# Build an undirected edge list from PublicDF
# Edges represent social connections documented in marriage applications:
# - Bride to Groom
# - Witnesses to Bride, Groom, or both depending on the For column

# Step 1: Preprocessing
# Temporarily prefix Groom with "aG" to ensure correct alphabetical sorting
# within each wedding group (Bride sorts before Groom, Groom before Witnesses)
PublicDF$Role <- ifelse(PublicDF$Role == "G", "aG", PublicDF$Role)

# Create a single grouping key from Volumen and Expediente
PublicDF$CitationKey <- paste(PublicDF$Volumen, PublicDF$Expediente, sep = ".")

# Sort by CitationKey and Role
PublicDF <- PublicDF[order(PublicDF$CitationKey, PublicDF$Role), ]

# Step 2: Initialize edge list
edges_undirected <- data.frame(
  Source = character(),
  Target = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Step 3: Iterate over each wedding group
for (cit in unique(PublicDF$CitationKey)) {
  group <- PublicDF[PublicDF$CitationKey == cit, ]
  
  # Get IDs for each role
  id_B <- group$ID[group$Role == "B"]
  id_G <- group$ID[group$Role == "aG"]
  w_rows <- group[grepl("^W", group$Role), ]
  
  # a) Edge between Bride and Groom
  for (g in id_G) {
    for (b in id_B) {
      pair <- sort(c(g, b))
      edges_undirected <- rbind(edges_undirected, data.frame(
        Source = pair[1],
        Target = pair[2],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # b) Edges for Witnesses based on For column
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(w_rows))) {
    w_id  <- w_rows$ID[i]
    w_for <- w_rows$For[i]
    
    if (w_for == "Both") {
      for (b in id_B) {
        pair <- sort(c(w_id, b))
        edges_undirected <- rbind(edges_undirected, data.frame(
          Source = pair[1],
          Target = pair[2],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ))
      }
      for (g in id_G) {
        pair <- sort(c(w_id, g))
        edges_undirected <- rbind(edges_undirected, data.frame(
          Source = pair[1],
          Target = pair[2],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ))
      }
    } else if (w_for == "Bride") {
      for (b in id_B) {
        pair <- sort(c(w_id, b))
        edges_undirected <- rbind(edges_undirected, data.frame(
          Source = pair[1],
          Target = pair[2],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ))
      }
    } else if (w_for == "Groom") {
      for (g in id_G) {
        pair <- sort(c(w_id, g))
        edges_undirected <- rbind(edges_undirected, data.frame(
          Source = pair[1],
          Target = pair[2],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ))
      }
    }
  }
}

# Step 4: Restore Role column to original values
PublicDF$Role <- ifelse(PublicDF$Role == "aG", "G", PublicDF$Role)

# Step 5: Remove temporary CitationKey column
PublicDF$CitationKey <- NULL

# Step 6: Write to file
#write_csv(edges_undirected, "edges_undirected.csv")
```

```{r}

  filter(Source %in% PublicDF$ID[PublicDF$For == "N/A"] | 
         Target %in% PublicDF$ID[PublicDF$For == "N/A"])

# Count witnesses with N/A in For column
PublicDF %>%
  filter(grepl("^W", Role), For == "N/A") %>%
  nrow()
```

```{r examine-missing-citations}
# Reload original edges file
edges_original <- read_csv("/Users/fproc/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-proctorf@denison.edu/My Drive/My Documents/work/Research Folder/Mexico Mapping Research/ArcGIS Mexico City/MC Social Networks/edges_undirected.csv")

# Get citation keys from PublicDF
publicdf_citations <- PublicDF %>%
  mutate(CitationKey = paste(Volumen, Expediente, sep = ".")) %>%
  distinct(CitationKey) %>%
  pull(CitationKey)

# Get citations from original edges file
original_citations <- edges_original %>%
  distinct(Citation) %>%
  pull(Citation)

# Find citations in original not in PublicDF
missing_from_original <- setdiff(
  as.character(original_citations),
  publicdf_citations
)

# Find citations in PublicDF not in original
missing_from_new <- setdiff(
  publicdf_citations,
  as.character(original_citations)
)

print(missing_from_original)
print(missing_from_new)
```

```{r check-citation-columns}
    Exp_max      = max(Expediente, na.rm = TRUE),
```

```{r check-duplicate-dates}

  group_by(Volumen, Expediente) %>%
  summarise(
    date_count    = n_distinct(Date),
    dates         = paste(unique(Date), collapse = " | "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(date_count > 1) %>%
  arrange(Volumen, Expediente)
```


```{r load-and-subset}
# Load source data
data <- read_csv("/Users/fproc/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-proctorf@denison.edu/My Drive/My Documents/work/Research Folder/Mexico Mapping Research/ArcGIS Mexico City/MC Social Networks/Marriage_DF_06_05_2025.csv")
```

```{r}

# Create working subset
publicDf <- data %>% 
  select(`Ref#`, Citation, ModDate, firstname, lastname, ID, sex, Role, Race, Status, Master_Reg, MasterID, Age, `For?`) %>%
  rename(`Wedding Number` = `Ref#`)
```

```{r build-publicdf}
PublicDF <- publicDf %>%
  select(1,2,3,6,4,5,8,14,9,10,7,13,11,12) %>%
  rename(Date = ModDate, EnslaverName = Master_Reg, EnslaverID = MasterID,
         Sex = sex, FirstName = firstname, Surname = lastname,
         WeddingID = `Wedding Number`, For = `For?`) %>%
  separate(Citation, into = c("Volumen", "Expediente"), sep = "\\.") %>%
  mutate(
    WeddingID    = paste0("W", str_pad(WeddingID, 4, pad = "0")),
    ID           = paste0("P", str_pad(ID, 4, pad = "0")),
    EnslaverID   = ifelse(is.na(EnslaverID), "N/A",
                          paste0("E", str_pad(EnslaverID, 4, pad = "0"))),
    EnslaverName = ifelse(is.na(EnslaverName), "N/A", EnslaverName),
    Volumen      = str_pad(Volumen, 3, pad = "0"),
    Expediente   = case_when(
      grepl("a$", Expediente) ~ paste0(str_pad(gsub("a$", "", Expediente), 3, pad = "0"), "a"),
      TRUE                    ~ str_pad(Expediente, 3, pad = "0")
    ),
    Race = case_when(
      Race == "Mz"    ~ "Mestizo",
      Race == "Negro" ~ "Black",
      Race == "Ind"   ~ "Indio/a",
      Race == "Esp"   ~ "Spaniard",
      Race == "Mozam" ~ "Mozambique",
      Race == "Xoxa"  ~ "Xhosa",
      Race == "TNova" ~ "TerraNova",
      TRUE            ~ Race
    )
  )
```
